title: A lost answer followed by Try again can make a gym, a message to every gym, or AI credits twice
what: When the connection drops after HQ sent a save but before the answer came back, HQ says the gym server did not answer and to try again. The save may already have happened. Making a gym, sending a message to every gym, adding AI credits and writing a delete request carry no check for a repeat, so a second tap makes a second gym (and the first owner code is lost), a second message in every gym's bell, or double credits.
expected: A repeated save is recognised and done only once, or HQ says the save may have gone through and to check before trying again.
who: you (HQ), and every gym for a repeated message
how_often: rare: only on a bad network
fix_line: Send a one-time request number with each save and ignore a repeat; change the no-answer words to say check first

title: Errors in HQ and in the apps reach nobody; the System page card says not connected yet
what: When an HQ page or button fails, the reason is written only inside that browser's hidden console, and refusals from the server are not even written there. The server's own failures go to a log nobody is told about. The System page has an Errors and outages card that says it is not connected yet, so there is no error count, no crash count and no daily health line anywhere in HQ.
expected: HQ shows recent errors, crash reports and failed nightly jobs in one place, and a red line in Needs you when something broke.
who: you, and every gym hit by a failure
fix_line: Connect the Errors and outages card to the crash reports and server error counts, and add a Needs you line when they rise

title: When the 30-day sign-in runs out, the minute check jumps to the sign-in page and throws away what you were typing
what: HQ checks Needs you every minute. If the sign-in has just run out, that check sends the whole page to the sign-in screen at once, even while you are halfway through a feedback reply, a message to every gym or a new gym form. The typed words are lost.
expected: The minute check shows a Sign in again line and leaves the page alone; only a button you press takes you to sign in.
fix_line: Let the background check skip the jump and show a sign-in line instead

title: HQ counts gyms and payers today, but not activation, day-30 use or trial-to-paid
what: HQ shows how many gyms there are, how many are new this week, members, free trials ending and how many pay, all as today's snapshot. It shows nothing about whether a new gym started using the app in its first week, how many gyms or members are still active after 30 days, how many trials became paid, or how many leads were won. Decisions on pricing, onboarding and marketing are made without those numbers.
expected: A small set of numbers over time: gyms that started using the app in week one, gyms and members still active on day 30, trials that became paid, leads won.
fix_line: Add a Growth card with week-one activation, day-30 active, trial-to-paid and lead-to-won
